correctness.rationale: The gapwise construction is an explicit bijection for every prescribed increasing map and all valid ranks, including the empty map. Near-unit products reduce to two-multiset scalar products, yielding the exact 4,5,6,8 spectrum and all four multiplicity formulas. The standalone checker verifies all 1<=n<=4 monoid pairs and all near-unit pairs for 2<=n<=12; the proof, not finite tests, establishes the universal result.

value.rationale: A complete all-rank, all-target structure-constant formula for the natural increasing partial-injection inverse monoid is a substantive invariant. The sharp near-unit fiber spectrum has a missing value 7 and class-size formulas; aggregate product-rank statistics cannot recover this nonuniformity. Motivation is the interplay between Green-rank, ordered factorization and gap geometry rather than a random numerical slice.
